function.name: submit_resume_analysis
function.description: Submit the complete resume analysis with all sections

industry.description: Detected industry. Use EXACTLY one of the enum values. Key disambiguation rules: (1) 'technology': ONLY software engineers, web/mobile developers, DevOps, SRE, security engineers, cloud engineers — NOT data or AI roles. (2) 'data_engineering': roles building data INFRASTRUCTURE — data engineers, analytics engineers (especially dbt+Airflow+Snowflake/BigQuery), ETL engineers, data architects, data platform engineers, BI engineers who build pipelines. Anchor keywords: dbt, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, ETL, data pipeline, data warehouse. (3) 'data_science': roles doing ANALYTICS and MODELING — data scientists, data analysts, quant analysts, experimentation analysts, decision scientists, BI analysts who analyze not build. Anchor keywords: statistical analysis, A/B testing, hypothesis testing, regression, scikit-learn, Tableau, Power BI, pandas, forecasting. DO NOT use data_science for pipeline builders. (4) 'machine_learning': roles building PRODUCTION ML SYSTEMS — ML engineers, AI engineers, LLM/GenAI engineers, prompt engineers, MLOps engineers, ranking engineers, RecSys engineers, NLP engineers, CV engineers. Anchor keywords: PyTorch, TensorFlow, model deployment, inference, fine-tuning, RAG, embeddings, LangChain, MLflow, vector database. NOT for analysts doing one-off modeling. (5) 'product_management': PMs, TPMs, product owners, scrum masters, group PMs, CPOs. (6) 'engineering': ONLY non-software engineering — civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical, aerospace. (7) 'creative': designers, UX, art directors, animators, copywriters, photographers. (8) 'general': only when truly no other category fits.
